metric_denominator: min(5, number of distinct eligible relevant programs)
empty_truth: report zero-inclusive MAP and MAP on nonempty eligible targets separately
schedule_matching: same channel, positive half-open interval overlap; sum only unioned viewing time within each broadcast
unlabelled_airtime: ID 0 never becomes an item; retain channel-level context separately
split: Past-only base fitting; 18 May to 22 June development; 22 June to 27 July audit
candidate_pool: same labelled airing-program set per evaluation window for all methods
cold_start: identical training popularity fallback restricted to candidate programs
selection: development temporal validation; final later holdout audited before refit; no private-score-driven hyperparameter search
final_refit: only observed viewing history before test start; no test-window viewing
schedule_test_restriction: use test schedule only for airing availability/channel/time; do not fit content features from test-period metadata
submission: five distinct nonzero IDs in template user order, preserving user IDs as strings
truth: five most frequent qualifying programs in validation window; descending count, numeric ID ascending for undocumented ties
timezone: Europe/Kyiv inferred and checked against every duration
primary_selection_metric: MAP@5 on template users with five eligible distinct validation programs
secondary_metrics: all template users including empty truth
